# Ricardo Calvo Mendez

> Academic website of Ricardo Calvo Mendez, a PhD student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Purdue University.

## Main pages

- [Profile](https://rcalvom.github.io/): research interests, education, experience, service, and grants.
- [Publications](https://rcalvom.github.io/publications/): publication records and links to papers, slides, and BibTeX.
- [Talks and presentations](https://rcalvom.github.io/talks/): conference talks and poster presentations.
- [CV](https://rcalvom.github.io/cv/): web CV and official downloadable PDF.
- [About me](https://rcalvom.github.io/about-me/): personal background and photography.
- [Blog posts](https://rcalvom.github.io/year-archive/): published posts by year.
